note: Not artifact-qualified (no buildArtifact()/execution_hash in the page). binResult() takes an rnd generator function and a remnant mass-function array as arguments, so it isn't callable through the generic {fn,args,expected} JSON harness the other pure-fn fixtures use -- it is exercised by a bespoke test block in tier-c-known-value.test.mjs (Group 4) that reconstructs rnd=makeRng(seed) and mf=remnantMF(fbh,mbhPert) exactly as this fixture records, then calls binResult with the same seed. This fixture asserts REPRODUCIBILITY of the fixed-seed Monte Carlo, not independent correctness (see flyby-survival.fixtures.json for the same caveat on the sibling tool's simpler version of this MC). Value-only fixture, out of schema-validate.mjs's hash-bound coverage gate (OCS-FIXWAVE.md FW-1).

cases.name: a1000au_impulsive
cases.source: Seed-frozen: rnd=makeRng(20260717), mf=remnantMF(0.01,31), binResult(20000,18.2,1e4,0.5,1000,6000,rnd,mf,false). f_BH=1% fiducial, 31 Msun perturber, matches the page's own default grid.

cases.name: a100au_adiabatic
cases.source: Same seed methodology (a fresh rnd=makeRng(20260717) instance, so this case is independent of the first) with adiab=true; tMed pinned at the TCAP ceiling (1.2e10 yr / TCAP/YR) because the adiabatic-corrected diffusion coefficient at 100 AU is far too small to reach eCross within the cap -- an expected saturation, not an error.
